docs.summary: Every asset by GUID, one object each for the whole session. Assets stay loaded while something reaches them: a live scene, an object kept with [`DontDestroyOnLoad`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Scene~DontDestroyOnLoad), a hold, a root, or a load group. A walk from those roots runs about once a second, and an asset nothing reached for [`GracePeriod`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~GracePeriod) has its payload freed, sooner when over [`MemoryBudget`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~MemoryBudget). Reading an unloaded asset loads it again.

docs.summary: The project's or the player's own content. Mounted sources are asked before it, so they can add to it or override it.
Extra sources of assets, newest first: content packs, mods, files on disk or on a web server.

Adds a source of assets for the rest of the session or until [`Unmount`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~Unmount). A GUID or load path that several sources know comes from the one mounted last, so a patch or a content pack can replace what came before.
Removes a mounted source. Its assets that no other source provides become missing, keeping their GUIDs so whatever refers to them finds them again if the source comes back.
The source an asset's content comes from: the newest mount that knows the GUID, then [`Backend`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~Backend).

Advances the walk by this frame's budget, starting one when it is due, and frees what nothing reached once it finishes. Called at the end of every frame.
